title: X sends cease-and-desist to open-source project Nitter over alleged scraping | TechCrunch
summary: In 2024, Nitter’s flagship instance, Nitter.net, went dark temporarily after X rolled out new API restrictions. Nitter’s website states that the Nitter.net project is offline while its creator seeks legal advice after receiving a cease-and-desist letter.
